title: Add PDF OCR pipeline

context.summary: Add PDF processing on the derived artifact model with native text extraction, page artifacts and OCR-ready metadata.
context.background: TASK-39 routes PDF as a recognized modality but skipped it as processor_not_implemented. TASK-41 moved text outputs onto artifacts, which PDF can now reuse for chunking/search/indexing.

in: Route enabled PDF uploads to document.extract instead of processor_not_implemented.
Implement a dependency-light PDF extractor in @mindory/extractor-docling for native text streams.
Represent extracted PDF pages as page-level derived artifacts and text spans.
Propagate page source refs and page metadata into chunk/search results.
Record OCR configuration/skipped state in extractor metadata without mutating RAW originals.
Add integration coverage for PDF upload, chunking and search.
Update worker, pipeline and configuration documentation.
out: Heavy PDF rasterization, external Docling service orchestration or real OCR model execution.
Changing document_artifact_vectors or removing legacy chunks.

acceptance_criteria: Enabled PDF routing creates a document.extract job.
@mindory/extractor-docling extracts native PDF text into page records when text streams are available.
PDF extraction writes pdf_page artifacts and page-level text spans with page_number metadata.
Chunk metadata/source refs include page artifacts when chunks overlap PDF page ranges.
PDF document search returns source-backed hits through the existing document search endpoint.
OCR state is recorded as derived metadata and RAW originals remain unchanged.

manual_checks: Confirm PDF search hits include artifact/page metadata.

risks: The PDF extractor intentionally handles simple native text streams for MVP; complex scanned PDFs require the later real OCR/model profile.
OCR execution is represented as provider-ready metadata until a concrete OCR adapter is installed.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
